svg.title: Grow calibration segments at 370 °C using different precursor line pressures
svg.desc: The source reports a series of ternary-alloy segments using steps (iii) and (iv). Individual line-pressure combinations and segment growth times are not tabulated. This is a series context, not one inferred batch. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.
